messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's GPU surge. Summarizing action items, owners, and timelines so we don't lose momentum. Main causes: scheduler backpressure + quota exhaustion on eu-west + insufficient soft headroom for dedicated pools. Please ack and add updates inline.

TJ: Acked. Can we split the work into (1) short-term quota backstop, (2) scheduler tune patch, (3) runbook + rotation for triage?

maria: Yep. Proposed owners: (1) tj -> quota requests + emergency backstop, (2) devon -> scheduler tuning PR + tests, (3) sasha -> runbook + oncall rotation. I can help with validation and rollout gating.

devon: I'll open the scheduler PR today. Patch will: bump `scheduling.minReadyTime` to 45s for batch nodes, tighten preemption window, and add a soft cap for small pods. Local perf tests look good. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/452

maria: thx. devon, include the following repro command in the PR description so QA can run it: 
```bash
# synthetic burst that mirrored last night's pattern
kubectl run burst-client --image=busybox --restart=Never -- /bin/sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 400); do curl -sS http://inference.local/generate >/dev/null & done; wait'
```

devon: added. ETA for PR merge: EOD tomorrow if no regressions.

ops-bot: INC-3421 created: quota-backstop-eu-west. Assigned to tj. SLA: 72h to implement emergency quota increase.

tj: I'll submit a formal quota request to cloud-console and open a short-lived reserved pool as a backstop (1x A100 equiv). Targeting completion: 48h. I'll post request IDs when done.

sasha: For the runbook: I'll add a step-by-step triage checklist, the emergency quota play, and a `who-to-ping` matrix. Also proposing a weekly 15m "capacity triage" sync on Wednesdays to rotate ownership.

lee: +1 to the rotation. Can we add an automatic checklist in PagerDuty so the oncall sees the three action toggles (quota, scheduler, fallback model)?

maria: Good call. sasha, can you wire a PD runbook hook? If not, I'll take it.

sasha: I can wire the PD hook. Plan: update runbook by Fri 11:59pm PST, add PD checklist, and create a calendar recurrence.

tj: Note: quota request needs justification + traffic spike graphs. I'll attach the query below so we don't repeat manual work: 
```sql
SELECT minute, sum(gpu_seconds) FROM infra.metrics
WHERE cluster = 'eu-west' AND minute >= now() - interval '12 hour'
GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 120
```

maria: thanks. Action item recap (short):
- tj: emergency quota + reserved pool (48h) -> update INC-3421 with request IDs
- devon: scheduler tuning PR + repro & perf tests (EOD tomorrow) -> link PR
- sasha: runbook + PD checklist + weekly rotation (Fri) -> link runbook page
- maria: validate rollout and approve canary, coordinate with SRE
- lee: add PD checklist automation (assist sasha)

tj: ack. I'll also add a spike alert threshold for eu-west to reduce detection time.

devon: I'll add a unit test to the scheduler repo that asserts no starvation under 2x synthetic bursts.

maria: Let's reconvene in 72h in #incidents to close loop on action items. If any blocker, DM me. Thanks all :thumbsup:

lee: noted. Filing a small follow-up ticket to track rotation calendar -> TKT-789.

sasha: Runbook draft: https://go/redwood/runbooks/gpu-capacity-draft. Please review and comment.

maria: Final note — recurring pattern: morning retrains (04:00-06:00 UTC) are the highest risk window. sasha, can you add a scheduled suppression policy suggestion to the runbook (delay non-critical retrains by 2 hours)?

sasha: Will do.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly capacity triage meeting scheduled for next Wed 09:00 UTC.

maria: Closing thread for now. If you pick up an action, reply with "owner: <action>" so we can keep the checklist accurate.

tj: owner: emergency quota + reserved pool

devon: owner: scheduler tuning PR + tests

sasha: owner: runbook + PD checklist + rotation

lee: owner: PD automation + calendar ticket

maria: Thanks — will follow up in 72h.
